Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for harming the integrity of your working device, GFT & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, such as changing system settings, installing system-level software or stealing confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested if you need it for regularly repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request; it will not be approved without proper justification).

- GFT Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allow a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GFT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GFT Group may request LAR privileges.

Use the Service and Subcategory Windows Software Installation - I need software or a license installed on my computer) do not open this ticket
- Do you need temporary short or long term admin rights?: Short Term: Choose this if Group IT cannot perform the task for you (Please do not open this ticket if you need to install software just one time. Use the Service and Subcategory Windows Software Installation - I need software or a license installed on my computer)
- General Instructions:
Please provide the full name of your GHL employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

NOTE: If you are L6 and above, you don't need a manager approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.

The field below only accepts persons with Level L6 and above
- Project Manager Full name: Luca Marini (Verona) (Z12F)
- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name, please check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.
- Computer Name: ITPC021843 (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harm to the integrity of your working device, GHL & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, such as changing system settings, installing system-level software or stealing confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in the ticket request, it will not be approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients' requirements demand us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on:
PBX
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that require you to have admin rights:
I will need to configure the PC by installing all the necessary software including IntelliJ IDE, Eclipse, conEmu64, Visual Studio Code, rabbitmq, etc.
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rights are still needed.
- GHL Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GHL Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GHL Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GHL Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GHL Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GHL Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GHL Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
✘ Alter the base GHL

query_description: Il tuo PC risulta obsoleto e fuori garanzia. Ti cambieremo il vecchio PC Service TAG 4HMTL81 con uno nuovo. Ti abbiamo assegnato il nuovo PC con Service TAG 8LQG528 Provvederemo a spedirti il nuovo PC nella filiale di Milano. Puoi darci conferma della filiale? A breve riceverai due mail: 1)Una relativa alla nuova assegnazione 2)Una relativa alla restituzione del tuo attuale device (da non considerare in caso hai esercitato il diritto di prelazione) Questo ticket verrà aggiornato quando il PC sarà disponibile per il ritiro in filiale. Ti ricordiamo che hai la possibilità di riscattare il tuo vecchio PC. Per esercitare la prelazione è sufficiente confermarlo nel ticket, successivamente verrai contattato per eseguire una formattazione da remoto. Se ricevi una mail dove ti viene chiesto di restituire il vecchio, non preoccuparti puoi ignorarla. Il prezzo è di 60 € per PC e 160 € per MacOS. NOTE: Ricorda che la prelazione è valida se: Entro 7 giorni dalla data di creazione del presente ticket eserciti il tuo diritto di prelazione. Il vecchio PC viene formattato/riconsegnato all'ufficio IT entro e non oltre 30 giorni dalla data di ritiro del nuovo device. Link utili: - Policy di assegnazione dei dispositivi aziendali https://short.url/policy - Guide IT [help.gft.com](https://short.url/guides) L'IT provvederà alla cancellazione sicura dei tuoi dati ed al ripristino come condizioni di fabbrica del tuo vecchio pc. ------------------------------------------------- Your PC is obsolete and out of warranty. baseline.answer:
Hi,

Updating Nextcloud is considered a one-time software action. Please do not request permanent administration rights for this purpose. Instead, submit a request through:

**Windows Software Installation → I need software or a license installed on my computer**

Please include that the request is to update Nextcloud and provide the required version or update details.

If you need to perform administrative tasks regularly, submit the **Extra information needed to request admin rights on the computer** form and include:

- Your L6-or-above LYS manager or approver
- Computer name
- Operating system
- Clients/projects involved
- Justification and the administrative actions required

Please also confirm with your manager that local administrator rights do not conflict with any client requirements.

✔️ Only personnel from GHT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GHT Group is eligible and may be installed.

✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GHT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GHT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

? Alter the base GHT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)

baseline.answer:
Hello,

Azure is the appropriate platform for this request. Please submit the request through the iTOP **Azure** category using the “Extra information needed to request a new virtual machine” form. Please note that **only one VM may be requested per ticket**.

Please provide or confirm the following information in the form:

- VM name
- Environment: QA
- Purpose/business case, including the SFTP migration from the QWERTYSFTPQA machines
- Operating system: Ubuntu LTS
- Requested size: 2 CPU cores and 8 GB RAM (B2ms)
- XYZ employee manager at L5 or above for approval
- System owner, local administrators, and users with access
- Source IP/DNS details for SSH access and SSH public keys, if applicable
- Network/VLAN requirements
- Estimated lifetime/end date
- Whether an additional data disk or network card is required

If the VM or SFTP service must be accessed from outside XYZ, select **Yes** and submit a separate request under **Network – I need to enable or change access to an internal web service from the Internet**. Please specify the required VPN, whitelist, or other connectivity requirements there. The current exposure and any existing tunnel or allowlist should be confirmed as part of that network request.

Please also note that creating an Azure subscription requires an approved purchase request, as the costs are not carried by Group IT.

As the requester, you will be responsible for keeping non-Group-IT software up to date and applying all security patches. Group IT Security Management may restrict access to or shut down the VM to mitigate unfixable vulnerabilities.

Once the Azure VM form, required approval, and any network request are submitted, the request can be assessed.

Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, GFG & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Tech Bank - Credit Development(IMUW)
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
jdk
maven
Spring Tool Suite
postman

- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rights are still needed.
- GFG Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFG Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GFG Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GFG Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFG Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFG Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GFG Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFG Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the GFG/IT Infrastructure
